mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 59 degrees and clear at Harriet Park under a full moon. We are seeing an air quality index of 52, so please be aware of that level. Also, the space station will be visible starting at 5:01 AM, rising near Verona High School and traveling toward the east northeast over the Fitchburg area for about five minutes.

Verona is prioritizing community well-being by designating September 2026 as both Hunger Action Month and Suicide Prevention Month, while also honoring our building and code staff today for their hard work keeping our infrastructure safe.

There is plenty to do, including the Dane County Farmers Market today, live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, families can look forward to the Kids Triathlon at the high school and a Girls Try Hockey event at the ice arena.
On August 21, an officer conducted a traffic stop for expired registration and subsequently cited the driver for possession of marijuana after detecting an odor in the vehicle.
Today's flavor is Mint Explosion, and you can pick it up when the store opens today at 10:00 AM.
